text:
Priya M.: dropping two lightweight flows for first-run testing: a mini concierge checklist (top-right, stepper) vs a compact spotlight banner (bottom center) with sample project tiles. comps: https://fig.redwood/onboard/concierge.png and https://fig.redwood/onboard/spotlight.png
Kellen (Design): concierge is great for guiding users through 3 quick wins; spotlight surfaces samples better. concern: concierge might feel prescriptive.
Vikram (Eng): engineering note 1 concierge needs per-step telemetry and resume state; spotlight needs lazy thumbnails and avoid layout shift. both require dismiss persistence.
Priya M.: copy sketches:
```
Concierge headline: "Complete these 3 quick steps to launch"
Concierge CTA: "Start checklist"
Spotlight headline: "Try a working sample in seconds"
Spotlight CTA: "Open sample"
```
Margo (a11y): a11y nits: concierge step changes must be announced via aria-live polite; ensure role=progressbar + accessible labels for step counts. spotlight must have clear heading hierarchy, image alt text, and 4.5:1 CTA contrast. also keyboard dismiss must be obvious.
Jordan (Growth): small-CTA wording matters1 verbs + time promise higher lift. suggest A/B: "Start checklist" vs "Launch sample". recommend 3-way split: 40% concierge, 40% spotlight, 20% control. target metric: create-within-48h.
Vikram (Eng): will add feature flag exp.onboard.concierge_vs_spotlight.v1 and persist dismissed state in user prefs. can we scope event names?
Priya M.: events: onboard.impression, onboard.cta_click, onboard.checklist_step, onboard.checklist_complete, project.create. Jordan will wire dashboards.
NotifBot: Experiment flag exp.onboard.concierge_vs_spotlight.v1 created and enabled for 40/40/20 rollout.
Margo (a11y): I'll run keyboard + VoiceOver smoke after builds. quick checklist i'll post here (tab order, aria-live, focus restore, contrast).
Kellen (Design): i'll bump contrast, add 3px focus ring, and upload updated frames by EOD. also adding microcopy variants in Figma.
Vikram (Eng): tickets: ONB-502 (impl flag + persist), ONB-503 (telemetry hooks). assigning to eng-squad.
Jordan (Growth): power calc: need ~2.8k new orgs per arm for 3pp lift detection. I'll publish dashboard and expected ETA in /drive/onboard/exp_reports.
Priya M.: action list: Kellen update comps, Vikram stub flags & events, Margo a11y QA, Jordan monitor. reconvene after 7 days of data. :sparkles:
